services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Explore the wildlife of the bay! Students & Chaperones $15 per person Teachers Free 1 Hour or 90 Minutes About Our field trips feature three activities: On the way out, we drag our plankton net. We then let you use our microscopes to view the tiny zooplankton. The second activity is the shrimp net drag. The boat is equipped with a built-in touch tank aquarium. After dragging our shrimp net, we empty our catch in the touch tank for you to see. The deckhand carefully removes any dangerous organisms and then allows you to see and touch certain species. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Cruise into the sunset! 3 Hours About Our sunset cruises leave Dauphin Island Marina and begin sailing west along the Coast of Dauphin Island. We get an up close look at the oil and natural gas rigs in Mobile Bay and the Mississippi Sound. On our cruises, we also drag a shrimp net. The boat is equipped with a built-in touch tank aquarium. After dragging our shrimp net, we empty our catch in the touch tank for you to see. We often see dolphins as we drag our shrimp net too! We conclude our cruise by watching a relaxing sunset as we return to the dock. What To Bring: Camera to capture All Ages • 3 Hours
